title: On the profitability of behaviour‐based price discrimination under purchase‐dependent preferences
title_zh: 基于购买依赖偏好下行为导向价格歧视的盈利性研究
title_primary: 基于购买依赖偏好下行为导向价格歧视的盈利性研究
title_secondary: On the profitability of behaviour‐based price discrimination under purchase‐dependent preferences
abstract: We study optimal monopoly pricing of non‐durable goods over two periods when consumer preferences evolve endogenously. We introduce a propensity for a second purchase that defines the influence of the first‐period purchase on the second‐period willingness to pay for the product, reflecting either satiation or habit. With this setting, second‐period demand depends on first‐period purchase and price, raising a dynamic pricing problem. Optimal pricing is analyzed with, at the second period, either uniform pricing or price discrimination between past and new buyers. We show that the propensity for a second purchase affects the capacity of the monopoly to commit on the pricing scheme and on second‐period prices. In particular, the monopoly, if able, cannot escape from discriminating between past and new buyers at the second period. However, this pricing scheme is more profitable for the monopoly, as compared to uniform pricing, if there is strong enough satiation. Moreover, the monopoly can commit on second‐period prices only with uniform pricing and habit. These results contrast with the standard literature on dynamic pricing and behaviour‐based price discrimination.
abstract_zh: 我们研究当消费者偏好内生演变时，非耐用品在两期内的最优垄断定价问题。我们引入一种二次购买倾向，该倾向定义了第一期购买对第二期产品支付意愿的影响，反映饱足感或习惯效应。在此设定下，第二期需求依赖于第一期的购买行为及价格，从而引出一个动态定价问题。我们分析了在第二期采用统一定价或对老顾客与新顾客实施价格歧视时的最优定价策略。研究表明，二次购买倾向影响垄断者在定价方案及第二期价格上的承诺能力。特别是，若垄断者有能力，则无法在第二期避免对新老顾客实施价格歧视。然而，当饱足感足够强时，相较于统一定价，这种价格歧视方案对垄断者更为有利。此外，垄断者仅在统一定价且存在习惯效应的情况下，才能对第二期价格作出承诺。这些结果与动态定价及基于行为的价格歧视的标准文献形成对比。

title: DP20363 Corporate Runs and Credit Reallocation
title_zh: 企业挤兑与信贷再配置
title_primary: 企业挤兑与信贷再配置
title_secondary: DP20363 Corporate Runs and Credit Reallocation
authors: Elena Carletti, Filippo De Marco, Vasso Ioannidou, Enrico Sette
official: 官方在线 2025-06-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the reaction of corporate clients to bank distress on both sides of banks’ balance sheet, exploiting the 2017 failure of two Italian regional banks. We find that firms initiate deposit runs before households, as soon as the banks’ distress becomes public. At the same time, an endogenous deterioration unfolds on the asset side: while risky firms draw down existing credit lines from distressed banks, creditworthy firms seek new lending relationships with healthier banks. Only the riskier firms reduce investment, as creditworthy firms successfully switch to other banks, which in turn reallocate credit away from riskier firms.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业客户对银行困境在银行资产负债表两端的反应，利用2017年两家意大利地区性银行的倒闭事件。我们发现，在银行困境公开后，企业客户比家庭客户更早开始存款挤兑。与此同时，资产端出现内生性恶化：风险较高的企业从困境银行提取现有信贷额度，而信用良好的企业则寻求与更健康银行建立新的借贷关系。只有风险较高的企业减少投资，因为信用良好的企业成功转向其他银行，而这些银行反过来将信贷从风险较高的企业重新分配出去。

title: Comparing Indirect Inference and Likelihood testing: asymptotic and small sample results
title_zh: 间接推断与似然检验的比较：渐近性与小样本结果
title_primary: 间接推断与似然检验的比较：渐近性与小样本结果
title_secondary: Comparing Indirect Inference and Likelihood testing: asymptotic and small sample results
authors: David Meenagh, Patrick Minford, Michael R. Wickens, Yongdeng Xu
official: 官方在线 2015-08-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Indirect Inference has been found to have much greater power than the Likelihood Ratio in small samples for testing DSGE models. We look at asymptotic and large sample properties of these tests to understand why this might be the case. We find that the power of the LR test is undermined when re-estimation of the error parameters is permitted; this offsets the effect of the falseness of structural parameters on the overall forecast error. Even when the two tests are done on a like-for-like basis Indirect Inference has more power because it uses the distribution restricted by the DSGE model being tested.
abstract_zh: 间接推断已被发现在小样本中检验DSGE模型时，其功效远高于似然比检验。我们考察这些检验的渐近性质和大样本性质，以理解为何会出现这种情况。我们发现，当允许重新估计误差参数时，似然比检验的功效会受到削弱；这抵消了结构参数错误对整体预测误差的影响。即使两种检验在同等基础上进行，间接推断仍具有更高功效，因为它利用了所检验DSGE模型所限制的分布。

title: Graying Asia: How Aging Is Reshaping Banking
title_zh: 亚洲老龄化：老龄化如何重塑银行业
title_primary: 亚洲老龄化：老龄化如何重塑银行业
title_secondary: Graying Asia: How Aging Is Reshaping Banking
authors: Haibo Li & Estelle X Liu & Yinqiu Lu & Anne Oeking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper explores how demographic shifts, particularly population aging, are reshaping banking in Asia-Pacific’s bank-dominated financial systems. Using household surveys as well as bank-level and country-level panel data, we show that aging populations are associated, with shifts in bank portfolios away from traditional loans (with lower loan-to-deposit and loan-to-asset ratios), driven by changes in households’ financial behavior. These changes affect banks’ funding structures, profitability, and risk profiles, with implications for financial stability. We also provide new evidence on cross-border dynamics, showing that demographic divergence spurs asset reallocation toward younger economies. Our findings highlight evolving risks and supervisory challenges as demographic transitions unfold unevenly across economies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了人口结构变化，特别是人口老龄化，如何重塑亚太地区以银行为主导的金融体系。利用家庭调查数据以及银行层面和国家层面的面板数据，我们表明，人口老龄化与银行资产组合从传统贷款（表现为较低的贷存比和贷资比）的转移相关，这种转移由家庭金融行为的变化驱动。这些变化影响了银行的融资结构、盈利能力和风险状况，并对金融稳定产生影响。我们还提供了关于跨境动态的新证据，表明人口结构差异促使资产重新配置向更年轻的经济体转移。我们的研究结果突显了随着人口转型在各经济体间不均衡推进，不断演化的风险与监管挑战。

title: 绿色发展视域下的新质生产力
title_zh: 绿色发展视域下的新质生产力
title_primary: 绿色发展视域下的新质生产力
official: 官方发布 2026-07-20 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 传统生产力及其发展范式无法全面实现人与自然和谐共生，全面推进中国式现代化需要全新的能源体制和工业模式。新质生产力的提出，从结构视角破解了这一难题，在统筹全面绿色转型与经济增长的同时，提供了从工业文明向生态文明转型的理论证成和实践指引，其根本宗旨在于引导建立“人、自然、生产力”三者之间的良性循环系统和持续正向反馈机制，孕育形成生态文明的内核。基于新质生产力的支撑，一个将自然资本收益内生化，以人的福祉为目标的发展范式将重塑人类文明。更进一步，论文阐释了新质生产力推动全面绿色转型，构建生态文明的理论逻辑与方法论基础，在此基础上提出“宏观体制机制改革—中观产业结构跃升—微观技术创新”的实践进路。毫无疑问，新质生产力理论是马克思主义生产力理论的巨大创新，是中国经济学自主知识体系的重要组成部分。
abstract_zh: 传统生产力及其发展范式无法全面实现人与自然和谐共生，全面推进中国式现代化需要全新的能源体制和工业模式。新质生产力的提出，从结构视角破解了这一难题，在统筹全面绿色转型与经济增长的同时，提供了从工业文明向生态文明转型的理论证成和实践指引，其根本宗旨在于引导建立“人、自然、生产力”三者之间的良性循环系统和持续正向反馈机制，孕育形成生态文明的内核。基于新质生产力的支撑，一个将自然资本收益内生化，以人的福祉...

title: Coordination with Cognitive Noise
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We experimentally study how cognitive noise affects behavior in coordination games. Our key testable prediction is that equilibrium behavior depends on context, which we define as the distribution from which games are drawn. This prediction arises from players efficiently using their limited cognitive resources. Furthermore, this prediction distinguishes cognitive noise from a large class of alternative behavioral game theory and learning models. Experimentally, we find that subjects coordinate more frequently when game payoffs are drawn from a narrower distribution. Nearly 50% of the variability in behavior can be attributed to cognitive noise rather than alternative sources of strategic uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了认知噪声如何影响协调博弈中的行为。我们的核心可检验预测是，均衡行为取决于情境，即博弈抽取的分布。这一预测源于参与者高效利用其有限的认知资源。此外，该预测将认知噪声与一大类替代性行为博弈理论和学习模型区分开来。实验发现，当博弈收益从较窄的分布中抽取时，参与者协调的频率更高。行为中近50%的变异性可归因于认知噪声，而非其他战略不确定性来源。

title: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
title_zh: 治理、声誉、危机与复苏：一项实验研究
title_primary: 治理、声誉、危机与复苏：一项实验研究
title_secondary: Governance, reputation, crises and recovery: An experiment
authors: Thomas H. Noe, Michael J. Rebello, Thomas A. Rietz
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We model and experimentally test the relationship between a firm’s reputation and its governance when firms can repair reputation damage through reform. Our model shows that conditions for establishing a reputation depend on whether control of firm operations is delegated to professional managers. Moreover, although the option to reform always dilutes firms’ incentive to commit to reputable behavior, delegation ameliorates the dilution. We assess the robustness of our model to behavioral deviations from optimal behavior through a laboratory experiment. The results of this experiment are directionally consistent with the model’s predictions.
abstract_zh: 我们构建模型并通过实验检验了企业声誉与其治理之间的关系，前提是企业能够通过改革修复声誉损害。模型显示，建立声誉的条件取决于企业运营控制权是否委托给职业经理人。此外，尽管改革选项始终削弱企业承诺声誉行为的激励，但委托管理能缓解这种削弱效应。我们通过实验室实验评估了模型对偏离最优行为的行为偏差的稳健性。实验结果在方向上与模型预测一致。

title: Covariance Function Estimation for High-Dimensional Functional Time Series with Dual Factor Structures
title_primary: Covariance Function Estimation for High-Dimensional Functional Time Series with Dual Factor Structures
authors: Chenlei Leng, Degui Li, Han Lin Shang, Yingcun Xia
abstract: We propose a flexible dual functional factor model for modelling high-dimensional functional time series. In this model, a high-dimensional fully functional factor structure is imposed on the observed functional processes, whereas a low-dimensional version (via series approximation) is assumed for the latent functional factors. We extend the classic principal component analysis technique for estimating a low-rank structure to the estimation of a large covariance matrix of random functions that satisfies a notion of (approximate) functional “low-rank plus sparse” structure; and generalize the matrix shrinkage method to functional shrinkage in order to estimate the sparse structure of functional idiosyncratic components. The developed methodology can be used to estimate both the functional contemporaneous covariance and lag-h autocovariance matrices. Under appropriate regularity conditions, we derive the large sample theory of the resulting estimators, including the consistency of the estimated factors and functional factor loadings and convergence rates of the estimated matrices of covariance and autocovariance functions measured by various (functional) matrix norms. Consistent selection of the number of factors and a data-driven rule to choose the shrinkage parameter are discussed. Simulation and empirical studies are provided to demonstrate the finite-sample performance of the developed model and estimation methodology.

title: An Evaluation of Difference-in-Differences Methods Using Placebo Event Studies
title_zh: 使用安慰剂事件研究评估双重差分方法
title_primary: 使用安慰剂事件研究评估双重差分方法
title_secondary: An Evaluation of Difference-in-Differences Methods Using Placebo Event Studies
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Researchers are faced with the choice of which of the many recently developed difference-in-differences methods to use in practice. To assess these estimators’ relative performance for single-unit event studies, we conduct 134,000+ state-level placebo event studies across 13 estimators. We find that no single method dominates. Performance is context-dependent, with synthetic-control-like methods sometimes outperforming and sometimes underperforming two-way-fixed-effect-like and matching methods. Performance also varies across states at least as much as it does across estimators. Our results highlight the need for practitioners to conduct placebo tests to understand the performance of methods in their research context.
abstract_zh: 研究者面临如何在众多新近发展的双重差分方法中做出实际选择的难题。为评估这些估计量在单单位事件研究中的相对表现，我们基于13种估计量开展了超过13.4万次州级安慰剂事件研究。研究发现，没有任何单一方法具有绝对优势。方法表现具有情境依赖性，合成控制类方法有时优于、有时劣于双向固定效应类方法和匹配方法。各州之间的表现差异至少与不同估计量之间的差异相当。研究结果强调，实践者需开展安慰剂检验以理解其研究情境下各方法的实际表现。

title: Innovation, Human Capital, and Taxation: Evidence from a Structural Model of the Canadian Economy
title_zh: 创新、人力资本与税收：基于加拿大经济结构模型的证据
title_primary: 创新、人力资本与税收：基于加拿大经济结构模型的证据
title_secondary: Innovation, Human Capital, and Taxation: Evidence from a Structural Model of the Canadian Economy
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Canada’s innovation performance has been strong but shows limited upward momentum despite generous research and development (R&D) subsidies. This paper develops an endogenous innovation, multisector, heterogeneous-agent model calibrated to the Canadian economy to evaluate fiscal policies that promote innovation and growth. The impact of R&D subsidies depends critically on the supply of high-skilled labor. When the supply of scientists is inelastic, subsidies raise research wages, crowd out private R&D, and can reduce long-run growth. When labor supply is more elastic, subsidies generate substantial gains in innovation and output. The analysis also compares alternative policy instruments. Investment tax reductions and education spending foster innovation through capital deepening and an expanded supply of highskilled labor, delivering more robust gains when talent constraints bind, while personal income tax changes have more limited effects. R&D subsidies also increase inequality by disproportionately benefiting high-skilled workers, although these effects are mitigated when labor supply responds. Overall, effective innovation policy requires combining R&D incentives with policies that expand human capital and reduce distortions to investment.
abstract_zh: 尽管加拿大提供了慷慨的研发补贴，其创新表现强劲，但增长动力有限。本文构建了一个以内生创新、多部门、异质性主体为特征的模型，并基于加拿大经济进行校准，以评估促进创新与增长的财政政策。研发补贴的效果关键取决于高技能劳动力的供给。当科学家供给缺乏弹性时，补贴会推高研发工资，挤出私人研发投入，甚至可能降低长期增长率。而当劳动力供给弹性较大时，补贴则能显著提升创新与产出。本文还比较了其他政策工具：投资税收减免与教育支出通过资本深化和扩大高技能劳动力供给来促进创新，在人才约束趋紧时能带来更稳健的收益；而个人所得税调整的效果则较为有限。此外，研发补贴会通过使高技能劳动者不成比例地受益而加剧不平等，但当劳动力供给具有弹性时，这一效应会有所缓解。总体而言，有效的创新政策需要将研发激励与扩大人力资本、减少投资扭曲的政策相结合。

title: A survey-based measure of asymmetric macroeconomic risk in the euro area
title_zh: 基于调查的欧元区非对称宏观经济风险度量
title_primary: 基于调查的欧元区非对称宏观经济风险度量
title_secondary: A survey-based measure of asymmetric macroeconomic risk in the euro area
authors: Sara Boni, Martin Iseringhausen, Ivan Petrella, Konstantinos Theodoridis
abstract: We compute a common factor summarising asymmetries in the expected distributions of a large set of survey-based economic data series for the euro area. This expected skewness factor is distinct from lower-moment factors and can help improve forecasts of risks to economic activity and inflation. In addition, within a monthly vector autoregression (VAR), we show that revisions to survey-based expected skewness have macroeconomic and financial implications, even when the average assessment and expected volatility reflected in the surveys remain unchanged. The skewness measure could benefit economic policy institutions by supporting timely quantitative assessments of the balance of risks.
abstract_zh: 我们计算了一个共同因子，用以概括欧元区大量基于调查的经济数据序列预期分布中的不对称性。这一预期偏度因子区别于低阶矩因子，并能有助于改进对经济活动及通胀风险的预测。此外，在月度向量自回归（VAR）框架内，我们表明，即使调查中反映的平均评估和预期波动性保持不变，基于调查的预期偏度修正也会产生宏观经济和金融影响。该偏度指标可通过支持对风险平衡的及时定量评估，惠及经济政策机构。

title: EU climate aid and trade interests: strategy or byproduct of closer ties?
title_zh: 欧盟气候援助与贸易利益：战略还是关系深化的副产品？
title_primary: 欧盟气候援助与贸易利益：战略还是关系深化的副产品？
title_secondary: EU climate aid and trade interests: strategy or byproduct of closer ties?
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To what extent do strategic trade-related considerations influence the European Union’s allocation of climate aid? As a major climate aid donor and a global trade power, the EU has frequently been shown to prioritize economic interests, particularly those of its export-oriented industries, in its external actions. This paper investigates whether trade influences EU climate aid allocation and, if so, whether this effect reflects strategic efforts to enhance trade or is simply a byproduct of established ties and familiarity with trade partners. Using disaggregate, sector-level data on both climate aid and trade flows, we assess whether the EU directs aid towards sectors that serve trade interests, especially those where its export stakes are high. Results from two-part regression models provide mixed evidence regarding strategic allocation: On the one hand, the EU consistently favors sectors linked to its export interests in climate aid allocation; on the other hand, trade interests play only a modest role in shaping other aspects of that allocation. Beyond the EU case, the paper contributes to the broader literature on (climate) aid allocation and its links to trade, offering insight into the mechanisms that may shape this relationship.
abstract_zh: 战略性贸易考量在多大程度上影响欧盟的气候援助分配？作为主要的气候援助捐助方和全球贸易大国，欧盟的外部行动常被指出优先考虑经济利益，尤其是其出口导向型产业的经济利益。本文探讨贸易是否影响欧盟的气候援助分配，若确有影响，这种效应是反映了旨在促进贸易的战略性努力，还是仅仅是既有联系及对贸易伙伴熟悉程度的副产品。利用气候援助和贸易流量的分部门、部门级数据，我们评估欧盟是否将援助导向服务于贸易利益的部门，特别是其出口利益较高的部门。两部分回归模型的结果为战略性分配提供了混合证据：一方面，欧盟在气候援助分配中始终偏向与其出口利益相关的部门；另一方面，贸易利益在塑造该分配的其他方面仅发挥有限作用。除欧盟案例外，本文还对更广泛的（气候）援助分配及其与贸易联系的文献有所贡献，为可能塑造这一关系的机制提供了洞见。

title: Restoring existence and uniqueness at the effective lower bound with simple fiscal policy
title_zh: 通过简单财政政策恢复有效下限的存在性与唯一性
title_primary: 通过简单财政政策恢复有效下限的存在性与唯一性
title_secondary: Restoring existence and uniqueness at the effective lower bound with simple fiscal policy
authors: David Murakami, Ivan Shchapov, Yifan Zhang
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The presence of an occasionally binding constraint from the effective lower bound (ELB) in New Keynesian models often leads to multiple or no equilibria. The problem stems from a strong feedback loop between expectations (of inflation and output) and current outcomes at the ELB. With non-existence, the economy cannot settle into a consistent, stable outcome; whilst with multiplicity, non-fundamental shifts in beliefs might trigger belief-driven recessions. To prevent such outcomes, a policymaker needs to ensure their actions will produce a unique minimum state variable solution. We show that simple fiscal policy rules can introduce additional stabilising forces that dampen the feedback loop, thereby ensuring the existence and uniqueness of an equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 新凯恩斯模型中有效下界（ELB）偶尔具有约束力的存在往往导致多重均衡或无均衡。问题源于预期（通胀和产出）与ELB处当前结果之间的强反馈循环。在无均衡情况下，经济无法稳定于一致、稳定的结果；而在多重均衡情况下，非基本面信念转变可能引发信念驱动的衰退。为防止此类结果，政策制定者需确保其行动能产生唯一的最小状态变量解。我们证明，简单的财政政策规则可以引入额外的稳定力量，削弱反馈循环，从而确保均衡的存在性和唯一性。

title: The Demand for Global and Local Environmental Protection: Experimental Evidence from Climate Change Mitigation in Beijing
title_zh: 全球与地方环境保护的需求：来自北京气候变化减缓的实验证据
title_primary: 全球与地方环境保护的需求：来自北京气候变化减缓的实验证据
title_secondary: The Demand for Global and Local Environmental Protection: Experimental Evidence from Climate Change Mitigation in Beijing
authors: Lö, schel, A., Pei, J., Wang, R., Sturm, B., Buchholz, W., Zhao, Z.
abstract: In this study, participants from Beijing, China, were offered the opportunity to contribute to voluntary climate change mitigation by purchasing permits from two Chinese CO2 emissions trading schemes (ETS). Since CO2 emissions abatement is linked to other local benefits like the reduction in emissions of air pollutants, our aim is to separate the demand for local and global environmental protection. To this end, Beijing and Shenzhen ETS permits were offered. Our results indicate that a substantial part of the revealed demand for voluntary climate change mitigation in Beijing is driven by concerns for local co-benefits of CO2 emissions reduction. JEL Q51Q54
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，来自中国北京的参与者被提供了通过购买两个中国二氧化碳排放交易体系（ETS）的许可证来自愿参与气候变化减缓的机会。由于二氧化碳减排与减少空气污染物排放等其他地方性益处相关联，我们的目标是区分对地方和全球环境保护的需求。为此，我们提供了北京和深圳ETS的许可证。结果表明，在北京，自愿气候变化减缓所显现的需求中，有很大一部分是由对二氧化碳减排地方性协同效益的关注所驱动的。JEL分类号：Q51，Q54
